high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article or report discussing the review process of flight data for a space mission. The text at the top explains that the FAC (Flight Analysis Committee) will thoroughly review the flight data along with all related data from stage preparation at the launch complex to the countdown and lift-off. It mentions that the committee will analyze the flight data to pinpoint the exact moment of deviation. Below the text, there is an image of a rocket in space. The rocket appears to be in the process of launching, with its engines ignited and emitting a bright flame.
